extracted.intended_audience: prospective brides, wives, mothers-in-law, step-mothers, and married couples (general readership)
extracted.subtask_description: Prescriptive guidance and behavioural standards for women (brides, wives, mothers-in-law, step-mothers) on creating harmonious married and extended-family relationships; emphasizes tact, patience, love, and practical rules for interacting with in-laws and step-children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speak the truth in love (not in temper)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Speak the truth in love! In 'love,' recollect,--not in temper." Avoid being the cause of offences by temperate truthful expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Train yourself strictly to see excellent qualities in associates; refrain from blunt or harsh expressions that wound. Frowning down the blunt expression of opinion will reduce its social acceptability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid disagreeable frankness when another's comfort is the price
rubrics_metrics.description: It is not one's duty to be disagreeably frank if another's comfort is harmed by candour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An unkind sentence lodges in the mind like a small insect burrowing; remember past instances where needless unkind remarks caused lasting pain. Choose what to point out; do not needlessly call attention to negatives when positives exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate an eye for pleasant characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliberately look for and acknowledge the good traits in others so that their disagreeable traits appear only as foils to the good.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively encourage pleasantness, discourage rough speech, and be lavish with agreeable expressions (the author's 'sauce agreable' metaphor). Small acknowledgements (e.g., 'thank you') produce disproportionate positive effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be grateful for small favors
rubrics_metrics.description: Always thank people for even the slightest kindnesses (e.g., the policeman guiding across a street).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple thanks can change a person's demeanor and create goodwill; do not withhold acknowledgment because an act seems insignificant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be generous in pleasantness — don't point out the 'grease spot'
rubrics_metrics.description: Rather than nitpicking faults (the 'grease spot'), be lavish in praise and pleasant behaviour (drown neglected parsnips in fresh butter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer emphasizing positives and being indulgent in courtesy rather than correcting small slights publicly; avoid imperious or belittling corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marriage is not a reformatory
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not marry someone expecting to 'make over' or reform their fundamental character or entrenched vices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A man whose nature is stunted or warped by long habits of vice is unlikely to be truly reformed by marriage; engagement-time promises that fail before marriage predict continued failure after. Avoid treating marriage as a cure (not a 'Keeley cure').

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not idealize the potential for a partner's change
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize the difference between lover and husband — habits of affection and behaviour often change after marriage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand that the lover's romantic attentions may not continue in married routine; rely on common-sense, love, patience and tact rather than fantasies of complete transformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Married life requires abundant love, patience, and tact
rubrics_metrics.description: To live together peaceably for a year (and beyond) requires deep love, divine patience, and the wife's particular gift of tact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blend love with patience and use tact to smooth over ordinary irritations; the more love, the better the prospect of weathering faults.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not marry a man with serious vices (e.g., intemperance)
rubrics_metrics.description: A woman should not bind her life to a man whose appetites or vices are entrenched; this risks her happiness and the wellbeing of future children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider examples where a wife's devotion could not overcome a husband's alcoholism; weigh the moral and practical consequences, including the effect on offspring and household stability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider children and heredity when choosing a husband
rubrics_metrics.description: When deciding to marry, a woman must seriously consider whether she is doing irreparable wrong to unborn children by giving them an unprincipled father.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cast aside false modesty; deliberate honestly about the probability of children and their likely upbringing under a father's vices before marrying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware of romanticizing 'a dash of wickedness'
rubrics_metrics.description: The notion that 'a little naughty' makes a man more interesting is misguided; vice does not make a desirable life-companion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reject the belief that minor wickedness adds attractiveness; beware of valuing excitement over moral character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appreciate and respect your husband's mother
rubrics_metrics.description: A wife's affection or respect for her mother-in-law makes the husband happier and demonstrates love for him.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if the mother-in-law has peculiarities, the wife should keep her own criticisms private, aim to see the mother through the husband's eyes, and foster friendship for the sake of peace and the husband's feelings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mother-in-law should avoid jealousy and magnifying faults
rubrics_metrics.description: A mother-in-law often harms relations by being jealous, failing to recall her own youth, or magnifying the husband's partner's faults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The mother should be grateful to see her child happy, refrain from over-critical scrutiny, and appreciate good qualities rather than magnifying molehills into mountains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not perpetuate antagonism with jokes and sneers about in-laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Coarse jokes and lampooning of 'mother-in-law' roles predispose hostility and make real antagonism more likely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid repeating or accepting caricatures; taking such mockery for granted perpetuates the very evils it mocks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use perspective-shifting to cultivate empathy (put your own mother in the offender's place)
rubrics_metrics.description: When offended by a mother-in-law (or any relative), imagine your own mother or daughter in that position to temper judgment and encourage forbearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This role-shift helps you interpret actions as well-meant but clumsy attempts at love, making reconciliation easier.

rubrics_metrics.name: Never criticise your husband's mother to him
rubrics_metrics.description: Open criticism of his mother puts the husband in an impossible allegiance: if he sympathizes he is disloyal, if not he seems unfeeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preserve the husband's affection for his mother by keeping criticisms to yourself; this protects family bonds and your husband's feelings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not complain to your husband about your own family's faults
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid telling your husband the faults of your family or asking him to take sides; pouring out grievances primes him to act then feel betrayed if you later reconcile with them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you must talk, remain outwardly sympathetic but do not commit yourself; refrain from inviting him into family disputes ('I am not in it').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exercise tact and diplomacy in managing relations-in-law
rubrics_metrics.description: Successful management of in-law relations depends on deliberate tact, a refusal to take up arms, and the decision to see the good in others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize cultural conditioning that predisposes antagonism; consciously choose to be conciliatory and avoid sowing suspicion before relationship begins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step-mother rule: make yourself love the children
rubrics_metrics.description: A step-mother should begin by deliberately making herself love her husband's children; this authentic feeling makes subsequent governance and affection possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If genuine love is present or cultivated, half the struggle is won; act with conscious effort to foster affection rather than assuming resentment is inevitable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step-mother: add patience, tact, and pity to love
rubrics_metrics.description: Because of the 'hyphenized' status of 'step-', the step-mother must add extra patience, tact and pity to her affection toward the children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand the disadvantage of the 'step' prefix and compensate by gentleness, self-control, and steady consistent affection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control nervousness and avoid showing exasperation
rubrics_metrics.description: Children sense nervousness and a twitch of impatience; step-mothers must preserve calmness because the child's response mirrors the caregiver's temperament.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Govern children with a firm, steady, yet gentle approach (horse metaphor). If you cannot control your own nerves, you cannot effectively govern the children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid harsh tongue and unjust punishments with children
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep a rigid guard upon the harsh tongue; seal your lips rather than utter quick, scolding phrases. Children remember injustices for many years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not scold or be cross; strive never to be able to point to a single unjust act. Children rarely forget undeserved blows or unprovoked sarcasm.
